messages:
alisa: Heads up — seeing a cluster of tiny GPU pods getting stuck in Pending in eu-west2 this morning, then mass-evicted on preempt. ~30 evictions in 2hrs.

matt: Any affinity/taint changes rolled out?

alisa: Not that I know. Node events show repeated lease heartbeat jitter: attach/detach timeouts followed by scheduler rebinds.

sangeeta: I saw a spike in node-heartbeat-latency on the autoscaler metrics around 03:10 UTC. Could this cause the scheduler to treat nodes as 'cold' and prefer dense packing elsewhere?

matt: If lease heartbeats jitter, our placement can mis-evaluate locality and split tiny-gang pods across racks -> fragmentation. Then preemptive backfill kicks them out.

devon: Logs: 
```
I0323 03:12:11 kube-scheduler: pod xyz binding to node-a failed: lease timeout
I0323 03:12:14 kube-scheduler: binding fallback -> node-b
I0323 03:12:18 node-a: kubelet reattached, pod terminated by eviction controller
```

alisa: Ops graph: eviction rate correlates with NVLINK error counts on node-a group. Network flaps + heartbeat jitter -> node marked as suboptimal.

opsbot: Incident alert: evictions-eu-west2 increased 3x between 03:00-04:00 UTC. Ticket created: #INC-5159

matt: Short-term mitigation: increase lease grace period to 20s for eu-west2 canary pool? That should reduce false negatives. Also lower preempt backfill aggressiveness for tiny pods for 1hr.

sangeeta: Agreed. Also suggest enabling node label cooldown: when node recovers within Xs, keep it preferred for existing local pods. Helps with tiny-gang stickiness.

devon: Patch ready: 
```
scheduler-config: {
  leaseGracePeriod: 20s,
  backfillAggressiveness: 0.6,
  nodeRecoveryCooldown: 45s
}
```

matt: Can we canary on a single AZ in eu-west2 first? Don't want to impact global packing heuristics.

alisa: I'll spin a canary pool (50 nodes) in eu-west2b and apply the changes to its scheduler profile. Starting now.

opsbot: Deploy job started: scheduler-config -> canary-eu-west2b (job-6841).

sangeeta: Also adding a quick Grafana panel for "tiny-pod eviction rate by AZ" and heartbeat pctiles so we can rollback fast.

matt: Thanks. If this drops evictions, we should consider a longer-term fix: diagnose NVLINK flaps and upstream kernel tuning. Also evaluate making tiny-pod packing less sensitive to short-lived node heartbeat noise.

alisa: Canary applied. Will report back with 30m metrics. :eyes:
